 LearningShala, founded in 2017, is a trust\-first, data\-backed online degree platform focused on making higher education decisions clear and informed. The organization specializes in expert counseling and 1:1 guidance, helping students understand their options before committing to a program. **Role Description** 
 The Business Development Associate role at LearningShala is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Noida. This role involves identifying and qualifying new leads, conducting outreach to prospective students and partners, and nurturing relationships to drive enrollment and partnerships. The associate will conduct market research to understand trends in online education, competitor offerings, and student needs, and use these insights to inform sales strategies. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include delivering presentations and demos, maintaining accurate records in CRM tools, coordinating with counseling and marketing teams, and contributing to growth campaigns and initiatives. The role requires consistent follow\-up, meeting performance targets, and representing LearningShala with professional, student\-centric communication.

* Proficiency with CRM tools, basic MS Office or Google Workspace, and comfort with virtual meeting platforms.

**Company Description**
SHEARWATER–THURIDUR operates camp facilities that support industrial and project-based operations, providing accommodation, dining, and essential services for on-site personnel. The organization focuses on maintaining safe, clean, and well-managed living environments that enable teams to perform at their best. With an emphasis on operational reliability and service quality, SHEARWATER–THURIDUR values professionalism, accountability, and continuous improvement in camp management. The company encourages collaborative working relationships and practical problem-solving to meet daily operational demands. Team members are expected to uphold high standards of safety, hygiene, and customer service in all aspects of camp operations.
  
**Role Description**
The Camp Boss is responsible for overseeing all day-to-day camp operations, including accommodation management, housekeeping, catering coordination, and general facility upkeep. This full-time, on-site role in the Greater Chennai Area involves supervising camp staff, organizing work schedules, and ensuring that services such as cleaning, laundry, food service, and maintenance are delivered efficiently and safely. The Camp Boss monitors inventory and supplies, coordinates with vendors and service providers, and ensures compliance with health, safety, and hygiene standards. The role includes handling resident concerns, implementing camp policies, and maintaining accurate records of occupancy, staff performance, and operational costs. The Camp Boss works closely with project and HR teams to support workforce needs, manage check-in/check-out processes, and ensure a well-structured, orderly environment.
  
**Qualifications**

* Proven experience in camp management, hospitality, facility management, or related supervisory roles, preferably in industrial or remote-site settings.
* Strong leadership and people-management skills, with the ability to supervise diverse teams, delegate tasks, and maintain clear communication.
* Knowledge of housekeeping standards, catering or kitchen operations, and basic maintenance procedures for camp facilities and equipment.
* Familiarity with health, safety, and hygiene regulations, including emergency procedures and risk management in residential or camp environments.
* Good organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple operational priorities and respond quickly to issues.
* Competence in basic record-keeping, reporting, and use of office tools (e.g., email, spreadsheets) to track occupancy, inventory, and staff schedules.
* Strong interpersonal and conflict-resolution skills, with a customer-service mindset toward camp residents and internal stakeholders.
* Ability to work on-site full time in the Greater Chennai Area and adapt to changing operational requirements, including occasional extended hours.
* High school diploma or equivalent required; a diploma or degree in hotel management, hospitality, or facility manage

title: Independence Compliance Manager
description:
We are the leading provider of professional services to the middle market globally, our purpose is to instill confidence in a world of change, empowering our clients and people to realize their full potential. Our exceptional people are the key to our unrivaled, inclusive culture and talent experience and our ability to be compelling to our clients. You’ll find an environment that inspires and empowers you to thrive both personally and professionally. There’s no one like you and that’s why there’s nowhere like RSM.
  
  
The Office of Risk Management (“O.R.M”) supports the implementation of programs, policies, and practices to manage RSM US (or “Firm”) risk. The Independence Operations Manager 2 will assist with managing day to day risk to the firm regarding independence requirements of regulatory bodies, including the Securities Exchange Commission, Public Company Accounting Oversight Board, and the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants. The Manager 2 will coach and manage a team of individuals responsible for processing updates to the entity management system (“EMS”) based on the relevant auditor independence rules. This will involve managing those who perform the intake and analysis process of the relevant submissions and the final review process prior to system update, including hosting phone and video calls with engagement teams to clarify updates. As a subject matter expert on the independence affiliate rules, they will also coach the Operations team and other stakeholders on the affiliate rules. The candidate may also be involved in related tasks, including training, data cleansing, and other relevant duties. The Manager 2 will lead the creation and continuous improvement of processes designed to maximize the firm’s system of quality controls to ensure timely and effective updates to the EMS.
  
  
**Essential Duties**

* Management and oversight of the Independence Operations Team, including creating and reviewing process documents, training materials, and other resources to assist the team’s success and growth
* Assisting the Operations team, Client Engagement teams, and other stakeholders with understanding independence affiliate rules
* Maintenance of EMS relationships and data, conducting consultations with client servers, and reviewing proposed edits to the EMS, especially in times of high volume
* Identifying opportunities for, and proposing and implementing, process improvements
* Providing performance reviews and career guidance to junior staff
* Management of team’s growth, including liaising with USI Human Resources to recruit and onboard new team members
* Other duties, as assigned

* Bachelor’s degree in accounting (preferred) or other business degree

title: Staff Streaming/Messaging Infra Engineer
description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

**About the Team and the Role**
Join the infrastructure engineering team responsible for building, scaling, and operating eBay’s core messaging and real-time streaming platforms. Our infrastructure powers mission-critical, high-throughput applications across eBay's global ecosystem.

In this role, you will act as a core developer and architect, taking full ownership of both the
**control plane and data plane**
for our distributed streaming platforms—including Apache Flink and Apache Kafka—deployed across multiple private cloud Kubernetes clusters spanning various Availability Zones (AZs) and Data Centers (DCs). You will also play a key role in designing and evolving our next-generation streaming lakehouse storage systems.

**What You'll do**

* Build a cloud-native distributed systems
  **:**
  Design and develop core Streaming components, supporting independent scaling, high availability, and fault tolerance.
* Solve distributed systems challenges
  **:**
  Design and implement replication, consistency, crash recovery, failover, and distributed coordination mechanisms.
* Build Streaming Lakehouses: Lead the design and development of our real-time streaming lakehouse storage architecture, enabling low-latency analytical workloads at massive scale.
* Ensure Operational Excellence: Drive high availability, automated fault recovery, and zero-downtime operations for large-scale production streaming topologies.
* Enhance System Observability: Advance enterprise monitoring, distributed tracing, automated alerting, and failure-diagnosis tooling to maximize platform uptime.
* Collaborate Globally: Partner with cross-functional architecture and platform teams worldwide to shape the future of eBay's real-time data ecosystem.
* Leverage AI-assisted engineering
  **:**
  Use modern AI coding agents to accelerate development, testing, debugging, and validation while maintaining high engineering standards.

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* **8+ years of experience**
  building production-grade systems software, databases, storage engines, or large-scale distributed systems, or equivalent demonstrated expertise.
* Core Distributed Systems Experience: Deep hands-on back
